name: Newfoundland and Labrador Hydro Wetland Conservation and Rehabilitation Funding
summary: Annual funding pool under the Muskrat Falls Wetland and Riparian Plan for wetland conservation and rehabilitation projects in Newfoundland and Labrador, running 2024 to 2033. Priority goes to Indigenous groups, municipalities, NGOs and community groups.

status.quote: If you are interested in applying please complete our application form and return to wetlandproposal@nlh.nl.ca by March 31, 2027 for consideration for the 2027 funding allocation period.

deadline.quote: If you are interested in applying please complete our application form and return to wetlandproposal@nlh.nl.ca by March 31, 2027 for consideration for the 2027 funding allocation period.

applicant_types.quote: While we accept applications from any group, the Plan specifies some funding priorities: Indigenous groups and/or partnerships in Labrador for wetland conservation and/or rehabilitation projects or initiatives in Labrador; Municipalities, non-governmental organizations and community groups for wetland conservation and rehabilitation projects or initiatives in Labrador;

geography.quote: support wetland conservation and rehabilitation in Newfoundland and Labrador over a 10-year period, from 2024 to 2033.

access.quote: If you are interested in applying please complete our application form and return to wetlandproposal@nlh.nl.ca

window.quote: If you are interested in applying please complete our application form and return to wetlandproposal@nlh.nl.ca by March 31, 2027 for consideration for the 2027 funding allocation period.

pool.quote: Hydro will provide up to $100,000 per year in funding to groups and organizations to support wetland conservation and rehabilitation
